name: open-parametric-cad
description: Browser-based parametric B-Rep CAD application using a Zig WebAssembly kernel, C++ Differential Oracle Harness, and Three.js Web Worker frontend

scripts.build: npm run build:kernel && npm --prefix web-app run build
scripts.test: npm run test:kernel && npm run test:oracle && npm run test:web
scripts.test:kernel: cd kernel-zig && zig build test --summary all
